jobs_results.title: Project Installation Manager (PrYM)
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80.000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time Project Installation Manager in Madrid we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your Project Management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and talented teammates.

You'll plan and manage all Installation activities for the project in support to the Project Manager ensuring application of the project’s strategy (including QCD commitment) and compliance with D&IS SIG and SECURITY strategy, policies, standards, local regulations and professional standards. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with... teams across the business (Project Manager and Project Core Team, Regional Centre Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager, Regional Centre EHS Manager)

You’ll specifically take care of managing internal interfaces within Project: Projects Engineering, Industrial, Supply Chain, Test and Commissioning, Sourcing, …; and external technical interfaces: Partners, Third Parties and Customers.

We’ll look to you for:
• Organising the Installation work (To be described in the Project Installation Management Plan) and Manages Installation Work Package (QCD). Monthly Work Package review with PM to control, analyses and evaluates costs and resources evolution, deviations, material, schedule, Risk identification and mitigation plan for Installation activities, … under the required tool (ADEL)…
• Delivering engineering studies (Bill of Installation Materials / Quantities, Method Statements, Installation Materials Specification Requirements, Installation drawings and configuration)
• Assisting procurement (Focus on Installation supplier)
• Preparing and managing Installation (Installation work, Work permit, Interface with Warehouse, …) including Installation supplier and Subcontractor / Installer
• Ensuring EHS on field with guidance and support from the Project team member in charge of Project EHS coordination Adheres to Alstom zero deviation policies and makes sure installer or sub-contractor follow the Alstom EHS polices.
• Monitoring / managing QCD performances (including EHS and RSA –Railway Safety), reporting and anticipating issues and monitoring milestone progress dashboard with regular project KPI reports.
• Assessing monthly the subcontractor and generates / acquiring from sub-contractor: Action plan progress, report, review and progress.
• Deploying and making sure the SIG and SECURITY Installation Process is applied as per the tailoring rules agreed with the RC IM. It is including:
• Regular updates of Installation Strategy Checklist, -Subcontractor share of responsibility and share of works as per project dynamics
• Performs / Acquires site investigations, surveys and field inspections as required by the customer or project needs
• Plans and schedules Installation activities as per handover from installation to T&C plan
• Reviews and signs off all installation design including: Installation Method statement, drawings, and manages site copies of drawing with Red & Yellow / Mark-ups, reviews and analyses subcontractor daily/weekly installation report. Manage of Punch list and regular follow-ups to close them. Ensures that “as built” drawings are in place before revenue service, including “as installed” configuration
• Reviews of Installation BOQ and updates as per project requirements. Supervising first article inspections and getting approvals from end user. Generates Traceability to installation requirements
• Lists Installation tools and organises regular inspections (calibration dates, notice to use, etc )
• Leads, manages, organizes and plans the installation activities with Alstom Installation Team and/or Subcontractors. Takeover of building / work place report (Civil works reception) –including punch list of remaining works to be done
• Decides start of work as per 4M Checklist for starting Installation Engineering and site installation activities
• Makes REX of Project installation activities and report on action.
• Supporting other Project worldwide as per RC IM request and participate to Process / “Metier” improvement workgroup as per RC IM request.

Organisational Reporting

Direct reporting: Regional Center Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager

Functional report line to Project Manager (during project execution)

Key Network & Links

Project Manager and Project Core Team

Regional Centre Installation Manager or RC / PO Field Operation Manager

Regional Centre EHS Manager

Performance Measurement

Quality Cost Delivery (QCD)

Savings through Risk mitigation and Opportunities management, Cash by sales milestones achievement

Quality, EHS, RSA (Railway Safety)

Quality of monitoring, anticipation and reporting on progress and quality

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering
• 3/5 years of experience/knowledge on field work execution in the railway sector. If this experience is in signalling and infrastructure activities, especially with ADIF, it will be a plus.
• Experience in management and evaluation of subcontractors
• Orientation and experience in EHS and AZDP control
• High level of English is a must
• Availability to travel is required
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

At Workday, it all began with a conversation over breakfast. When our founders met at a sunny California diner, they came up with an idea to revolutionize the enterprise software market. And when we began to rise, one thing that really set us apart was our culture. A culture which was driven by our value of putting our people first. And ever since, the happiness, development, and contribution of every Workmate is central to who we are. Our Workmates believe a healthy employee-centric, collaborative culture is the essential mix of ingredients for success in business. That’s why we look after our people, communities and the planet while still being profitable. Feel encouraged to shine, however that manifests: you don’t need to hide who you are. You can feel the energy and the passion, it's what makes us unique. Inspired to make a brighter work day for all and transform with us to the next stage of our growth journey? Bring your brightest version of you... and have a brighter work day here.

About The Team

In our Advisory Consulting Team, our mission is to drive customer self-sufficiency and satisfaction with Workday. We help our customers deploy and optimize functionality delivering efficient, effective, flexible and agile solutions. Our approach empowers customers to more easily support their growing and changing business needs within Workday.

We work with a wide variety of Workday customers, supporting clients of every size, industry and location with almost every aspect of their Workday tenants. Customer Enablement has a reputation for building trust and making a big difference in a short period of time for many customers. Team members say the variety of services and unexpected challenges keeps the job exciting and fresh!

About The Role

The Senior Project Manager will simultaneously handle several projects including Enablement and Workday Success Plan offerings, coordinating the delivery of packaged services to customers of all sizes and industries around the world. Senior Project Managers drive the execution of projects, ensuring success, efficiency and quality via project management practices (e.g., develop project staffing plan, coordinate system access, conducting meetings, etc.) and by handling the customer relationship. Within these projects, Project Managers serve as an advocate for Workday, our employees and our customers in equal measure, to complete projects under budget and on time per the definition of each service.

Responsibilities include:

• Leading projects to deliver Workday Success Plans programs and services.
• Clearly and successfully presenting project objectives and delivery strategies.
• Becoming a specialist in Workday's implementation methodology and using it on engagements.
• Balancing the needs of a large number of concurrent projects.
• Providing guidance and mentoring to Professional Service resources working on your projects.
• Ensuring projects are accurately planned and staffed.
• Working with the client project manager to identify and resolve issues that could impact project scope or timeframe.
• Leading customer meetings and Workday internal operational meetings.
• Finding opportunities to position other service offerings.
• Ensuring customers can serve as a reference upon completion of their project.
• Communicating and drafting change orders if Workday agrees to perform tasks outside of the scope of the SOW.
• Completing project administration tasks such as updating project forecasts, assisting with team scheduling, and other internal project initiation tasks.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

• Fluency in the English language (written and spoken)
• 5+ years of project management experience with HCM, Payroll, Financial or Student implementations within medium enterprise, large enterprise, higher education and/or state and local governments.
• 5+ years of experience implementing Workday, Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft or similar applications.

Other Qualifications:

• Passion for customer service
• Excellent organization, time management, verbal and written communication skills
• Solid understanding of at least one of the following business areas: Human Resources, Benefits, Payroll, General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Services procurement
• Capable of influencing, interacting and collaborating with senior executives, internally and externally
• Ability to work on multiple engagements simultaneously
• Ability to travel up to 10%

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process

jobs_results.title: Project Manager, OBU Medical Affairs
jobs_results.description:
Location: Barcelona (on-site)

At AstraZeneca we work together across global boundaries to make an impact and find answers to challenges. We do this with the upmost integrity even in the most demanding situations because we are committed to doing the right thing. We put patients first and follow the science to bring life-changing medicines to patients that need them.

We are currently searching for a candidate who can drive strategic planning and execution of the OBU EUCAN projects and accountabilities for the OBU EUCAN Medical organization. The role would include project oversight and budget management, change implementation, and cross-functional coordination with multiple teams in and outside of OBU Medical. This role would report directly to the Medical Innovation, Strategy & Operations Leader for OBU Medical but would partner closely with the VP & Head of EUCAN Medical Affairs and EUCAN Portfolio Director. The position will be based in Barcelona, Spain.

The ideal candidate will... be expected to work in a highly effective way with other project managers and leaders to implement global and regional strategies at all levels through the interconnected organisation. The ideal candidate can demonstrate their strategic thinking, problem solving skills, ability to work collaboratively and act decisively to support the broader goals of OBU Medical as a whole.

Accountabilities/responsibilities

Leadership Team:
• Partners with VP EUCAN and EUCAN Portfolio Director to implement goals, projects, budgets, schedules, and drive performance for the organization, and monitors progress and mitigates risks for delivery of responsible projects.
• Facilitates LT meetings including Regional Therapy Area Leader network forums, providing strategic input into meeting agendas, and manage action items from those meetings.
• Manage, partner with and coordinate multiple stakeholders (Global, Regional & Local), to ensure alignment of cross-Franchise and cross-Functional commitment to strategic objectives and support with initiatives (e.g. evidence generation, Portfolio prioritisation, Launch excellence etc.).
• Responsible for pull-through and implementation of key functional team deliverables such as scorecards, value metrics, department forums, walking decks, leadership presentations, etc.
• Responsible for oversight of and communicating status of responsible project budget, phasing and prioritization across the business planning cycle as well as rollup into Long Range Plans.

Project Management Team
• Partners closely with the Global Project Management Office to drive operational efficiency and excellence, streamline processes and methodologies, and identify continuous improvement and simplification, to optimise bi-directional Global-Region-Local communication and implementation.

Culture
• Encourage a vibrant, entrepreneurial and externally facing team focused on the delivery of successful projects and programs that support courageous leadership, innovation and collaboration.
• Collaborate strongly with other Project Leaders to embed standard methodology.
• Flexible attitude and dedication to efficient productivity.

Why AstraZeneca

At AstraZeneca when we see an opportunity for change, we seize it and make it happen, because any opportunity no matter how small, can be the start of something big. Delivering life-changing medicines is about being entrepreneurial -finding those moments and recognizing their potential. Join us on our journey of building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening new ways to work, pioneering cutting edge methods and bringing unexpected teams together. Interested? Come and join our journey.

So, what’s next!

Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company

jobs_results.title: Internship Event Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.

This position will support Fever Originals’ team. Your role will be to help the project manager with her daily tasks. This is an exciting opportunity to join the team at an early, high-growth stage and have ownership in creating new experiences.

The role requires a mix of business development and... operational experience. Candidates need to be passionate about the entertainment and events industry. You will have to be comfortable delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners, and think bigger about how we create a compelling experience.

This role requires flexibility, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines while staying within budget.

Strong communication skills are critical to success in this role. The right candidate will be a self-starter and have strong interpersonal skills.

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble, learn, and work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Participate in all aspects of event productions, including pre-production logistics planning, vendor selection, hiring, onsite execution, as well as post-event wrap-up
• Create productions timelines and ensure that teams are keeping to schedule
• Communicate and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive alignment and execution of event deliverables
• Manage multiple productions and help scale this Fever Original IP against team targets
• Deep dive in budgets of different scales
• Venue research and booking
• Handle administrative duties including expense reports, invoicing, and working with the legal department on contracts

REQUIREMENTS
• Native-level Spanish and fluent English skills
• Preferably having already an experience in the event production industry
• Ability to manage multiple projects at any given time and pull together multiple aspects of a project in an organized and efficient way
• Understanding of technical production requirements
• Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly
• You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then try to find solutions
• Have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships
• Able to communicate with partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
• Collaborative and willing to “get hands dirty”
• Availability to travel

You’re about to graduate and have strong analytical and communication skills. You’re thriving in a fast-growing and demanding environment and are happy to take ownership of exciting projects.

BENEFITS
• Paid internship
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
• Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
• Home office friendly
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
• We have free food, drink, and fruit at the office!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.

This position will support Fever Originals’ team. Your role will be to help the project manager with her daily tasks. This is an exciting opportunity to join the team at an early, high-growth stage and have ownership in creating new experiences.

The role requires a mix of business development and... operational experience. Candidates need to be passionate about the entertainment and events industry. You will have to be comfortable delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners, and think bigger about how we create a compelling experience.

This role requires flexibility, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines while staying within budget.

Strong communication skills are critical to success in this role. The right candidate will be a self-starter and have strong interpersonal skills.

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble, learn, and work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Participate in all aspects of event productions, including pre-production logistics planning, vendor selection, hiring, onsite execution, as well as post-event wrap-up
• Create productions timelines and ensure that teams are keeping to schedule
• Communicate and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive alignment and execution of event deliverables
• Manage multiple productions and help scale this Fever Original IP against team targets
• Deep dive in budgets of different scales
• Venue research and booking
• Handle administrative duties including expense reports, invoicing, and working with the legal department on contracts

REQUIREMENTS
• Native-level Spanish and fluent English skills
• Preferably having already an experience in the event production industry
• Ability to manage multiple projects at any given time and pull together multiple aspects of a project in an organized and efficient way
• Understanding of technical production requirements
• Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly
• You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then try to find solutions
• Have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships
• Able to communicate with partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
• Collaborative and willing to “get hands dirty”
• Availability to travel

You’re about to graduate and have strong analytical and communication skills. You’re thriving in a fast-growing and demanding environment and are happy to take ownership of exciting projects.

BENEFITS
• Paid internship
• Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
• 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
• Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
• Home office friendly
• Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
• Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
• We have free food, drink, and fruit at the office!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: SEO Project Manager - Stage de fin d'études
jobs_results.description:
Contexte
• Le/la SEO Project Manager Finance et Assurance est intégré.e au pôle Finance & Assurance & Rénovation énergétique à Madrid.
• Le pôle Finance, Assurance & Rénovation Énergétique de Selectra est le pôle le plus jeune du Groupe en France. Créée il y 4 ans, cette business unit a connu une croissance continue dans la lignée des activités cœur du Groupe, l’Énergie et les Télécoms. Dans un environnement intrapreneurial et particulièrement collaboratif, l’ambition du pôle est de devenir une référence dans le monde du courtage en assurance et dans la comparaison des offres de finance. Le leitmotiv du pôle est : “Agir vite et bien”
• Sous la supervision de la responsable de la Business Unit Finance & Assurance, Luka Payras et en étroite collaboration avec tous les membres de l’équipe, vous contribuez à la définition de la stratégie SEO et business du pôle.
• Améliorer le référencement web de nos sites en créant de nouveaux contenus optimisés SEO, en optimisant l’existant, en... investiguant de nouvelles opportunités lexicales. Développer vos capacités analytiques et organisationnelles en reportant mensuellement vos KPIs, en analysant les performances d’un site, en corrigeant les bugs ou en apportant un soutien sur des projets marketing transversaux.

Mission 1 : Développer et maintenir le positionnement de nos contenus dédiés à la Finance et à l’Assurance
• Développement rapide de votre expertise sur l’assurance afin de garantir la parfaite exactitude des contenus publiés
• Création de nouveaux articles selon les principes SEO
• Optimisation des contenus existants dans le but de gagner des positions ainsi que du trafic
• Selon le niveau du candidat, gestion d’un freelance : création de briefs, relecture des guides et facturation

Mission 2 : Mener des analyses technique d’un site web
• Réalisation de crawls à l’aide d’outils techniques et correction des erreurs soulevées (erreurs 4xx, redirections, etc.)
• Reporting et analyse des résultats mensuels du site
• Analyses des monétisations et du marché afin de trouver la stratégie commerciale la plus performante
• Faire un content gap pour trouver de nouvelles opportunités de mots-clés

Mission 3 : Améliorer la notoriété de Selectra Assurance
• Lancement d’opérations de marketing pour faire connaître l’expertise de Selectra en matière assurantielle dans les médias (études de marché, vidéo, support de formation etc.).
Compétences à acquérir durant le stage
• Les fondamentaux du SEO et des contenus optimisés
• Les bases en langage HTML
• Le CMS drupal
• Les logiciels d’analyse : ahrefs, screaming frog, Google search console, Google analytics
• Connaissances sur le secteur de l’assurance
• Compétences en gestion de projet

Pourquoi Selectra?
• Madrid ! Vous serez séduit par cette ville à l’atmosphère et à la culture de rêve où chacun se sent le bienvenu.
• Une entreprise avec un esprit start-up : la flexibilité et la réactivité sont au cœur de notre ADN, et chez nous l’ambiance de travail est détendue.
• Une entreprise véritablement internationale : nous comptons plus de 20 nationalités et faisons en sorte que vous puissiez parler avec tout le monde en offrant des cours de langue gratuits !
• Des événements d’entreprise réguliers : nous travaillons dur mais aimons nous détendre une fois le travail terminé : nous organisons des événements d’équipe mensuels ainsi que 3 afterworks par an.
• Une équipe dynamique qui sera là pour vous former et vous aider : vous serez responsabilisé.e tout au long de votre parcours tout en étant épaulé.e par votre équipe.
• Nous sommes bons dans ce que nous faisons : vous rejoindrez l’une des meilleures équipes de référencement en Europe et ferez partie d’une équipe internationale et multiculturelle de plus de 60 responsables de contenu travaillant quotidiennement sur le référencement.
• Nous nous soucions de votre santé et de votre bien-être :
• des tarifs préférentiels pour l’assurance maladie privée (gratuite après un an dans l’entreprise)
• des tarifs préférentiels sur votre abonnement Gym.
• Des fruits frais livrés chaque semaine
• Mais surtout, nous ne laissons jamais des situations malsaines s’installer sans réagir afin de garder un environnement de travail serein pour tous.tes.
• Nous vous aidons à vous installer dans votre nouvelle ville grâce à d’autres avantages (Diverclick, …

jobs_results.title: Video Game Localization Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description
Localsoft, S.L. is a world-class localization company offering translation, testing and audio services. From our headquarters in the Málaga TechPark, Spain, we operate both locally and internationally with clients from many different business sectors including leading brands in the Games, IT, Legal and Business industries.

We are expanding and currently hiring an experienced and dynamic Video Game Localization Project Manager to work in our fast-paced Localization Department with English as our main language of communication.

Visit: www.localsoftgames.com

Role

As a Localization Project Manager, you will manage multilingual projects in a deadline-driven environment taking full ownership of your projects from RFQ to final delivery, ensuring successful project completion and customer satisfaction.
• University degree: BA or MA in Translation, Philology, Linguistics or similar
• A minimum of 3 years of Localization Project Management experience
• Outstanding... Project Management skills: communication, planning, organization
• Able to successfully solve unexpected issues with minor impact and with a proactive and positive “can do” attitude
• Able to manage multilingual projects in a deadline-driven environment
• Able to negotiate effectively
• Games industry experience
• Quality evaluation practices and tools
• CAT Tools: Advanced user (agency), especially memoQ
• IT literacy: especially Microsoft Office suite
• Languages: English with full working proficiency, Japanese is desired, other languages are a plus
• Experience working with ISO-based requirements is a plus
• Experience with Japanese customers is a plus

Responsibilities
• Ensure customer satisfaction
• Successful project execution and delivery according to clients' expectations, time and budget requirements
• Full ownership of each localization phase
• Proposal creation, project analysis, planning and scheduling
• Risk analysis and mitigation plans
• Resource selection, monitoring and management
• Quality assurance
• Status reports
• Cost tracking
• Project admin, post-mortems, meeting minutes, etc.
• Follow and create procedures making recommendations for process improvements

What we offer
• Full-time position in a well-established localization/testing company
• Opportunity to work with a professional international team in a dynamic and friendly work environment
• Opportunity to work with renowned clients worldwide
• Opportunity to work on exciting game projects
• 23 Paid holidays per calendar year
• 12 paid bank holidays per calendar year
• Summer timetable
• Free yearly medical check
• Cafeteria & Games
• Soft Drinks
• Fresh Fruit
• Free parking
• Relocation pack

jobs_results.title: Localisation Account/Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that rethink the established standards reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

As a Localisation Account/Project Manger you will be responsible for managing the language validation projects globally, together with the coordination and delivery across a range of divisions for a global account. You will... be working collaboratively with your account management, planning, & production team colleagues, and our pool of freelance writers and suppliers. You'll own – and be accountable for – each project from the point of project setup, driving it through to successful execution, ensuring that we produce the highest quality.

Reporting to Language Services Director/s on all Language Services process activity as required, and Account Director as applicable.

Your primary responsibilities will include:
• Oversee daily language validation projects, serving as primary contact between suppliers, our teams and end client
• Analyse client information and full validation briefs, schedules and defining the best language QA and / or localisation approach
• Accountable for project status, ensuring linguistic quality and service always meet expectations
• Identifying new strategies, approaches & workflows for your accounts for continued improvement.
• Adopting and implementing best practices and processes to streamline management and all associated admin consistently with other regional Language Services Team processes
• Attending internal team meetings to discuss and agree processes and unified, centralised ways of working
• Attending client meetings as necessary to discuss projects briefs, requirements, deadlines and budgets
• Putting together detailed and tailored linguistic briefs, for linguists and writers and always ensuring deliverables are in line with original client brief

Qualifications
• Qualifications - BA or MA in Translation, Localisation or similar language qualification or experience
• 2-4 years of proven experience in a transcreation / Translation project / account management role
• Experience with Project Management tools
• A thorough understanding and genuine enthusiasm for marketing transcreation and translation
• Client-centric - You'll love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.
• Team Collaboration - You'll be great at collaborating with team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions.
• Adaptability - You're good at adapting strategies and plans to navigate unforeseen circumstances.
• Problem Solving - When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll receive a loyalty salary increase on your Jellyfish anniversary, in addition to our company-wide annual bonus.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

📈 Growth, Your Way: Grow your career with one paid day each month for self-development and access to LinkedIn Learning with unlimited online courses.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to talentacquisition@jellyfish.com.

#LI-Hybrid

Presented in 25 countries , our 1,400 employees work in Europe , in the CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States) countries, the USA and in Asia . jobs_results.description: Job Description: Would you like to contribute to a company that has ‘’Feeding the Future’’ as its mission? Do you have experience as a Project Manager? Are you looking for a new challenge in an international animal nutrition company? Then Nutreco has this interesting position for you! What are you going to do? Nutreco's mission is to feed the future. We develop and provide innovative feed technologies, premixes and unique software solutions and services for the animal nutrition industry. In order to continue to fulfill our ambition as a market leader, the intrinsic demands for the growing business and customer support, the company is further investing in the area of Operations. The roles will give you a unique opportunity to work on Quality, HSE and Efficiency Improvement projects. As well as to co-create and further develop our models and solutions with access to a multi-disciplinary and highly motivated team. What are your key accountabilities? Project management Starting from the... high-level key deliverables (Masterplan) already defined and approved, you will lead the Planning phase in order to create an accurate Project Management Plan (PMP with baselines on scope, costs, steps, milestones and time etc.) Lead the Network Optimization project according to Nutreco project management methodology (based on PMI principles) Constantly review the project requirements and scope in accordance with stakeholder expectations and form project teams (internal and/or external). Identify risks, assess impact and severity. Have in place a risk mitigation plan. Coordinate decision-making meetings and make proposals to the Steering Committee. Materialize Quick Wins already identified, coordinating the teams to achieve them, and coordinate product allocation, production phase-in and phase-out. Ensure the successful completion of the project in terms of scope, schedule, costs and stakeholder management. Monitoring and auditing Generate reports regarding project status, including incidents and risks. Track and report on the project budget, scope, and schedule. Track operational efficiencies defined in the project and review with controlling team its contribution to cost reduction. Leadership and people management: Capable to build strong (national and multicultural) relationships, have excellent communication and network skills. Manage and coach a project team without having hierarchical authority; motivate employees through sincere and concrete feedback and take appropriate action when needed, to insure they are performing in accordance with their project objectives. Compliance Ensure that all activities are prepared and executed in line with all relevant Nutreco and local safety regulations and procedures (work permits, LoTo, etc.), as well as technical standards, regulations, procedures, instructions and guidelines. Signal potential hazardous and / or unsafe situations on site and during construction activities, take appropriate action in case of imminent unsafe situations. What we offer Flexible working hours and hybrid model work Reduced working hours on Fridays and over summer 26 days of paid vacation Subsidised meals in our canteen Private health insurance (partly paid by the company) Personal development programs, online training, and opportunities to get involved in different projects depending on your interests Regular company and team events What you need to succeed Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or technical field (PMP certified strongly preferred) Proven international experience in strategic interdepartmental projects Experience with project management SW tools. Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills, hands-on mentality, and result-driven Previous experience working on process standardization Able to demonstrate strong numerical capability with a passion for detailed analysis Interpersonal skills, stakeholder management, open to listening to others' ideas, builds and maintains strong relationships, and has cross-cultural awareness Fluent in both English/Spanish Willingness to travel across Spain and Portugal (10%) Extra information / Apply direct Are you the perfect candidate we are looking for? We would like to hear from you! You can express your interest in this role by clicking the button “apply online’’ and we will contact you as soon as possible. In case you do apply, we like to thank you for sharing your ambition with us! Our organisation: Trouw Nutrition is the global leader in innovative feed specialties, premixes and nutritional services for the animal nutrition industry. Trouw Nutrition provides species-specific nutritional solutions consisting of feed concepts, products and nutritional know-how. The unique combination of products, models and services Trouw Nutrition offers, boosts productivity and supports animal health through all life stages, contributing to our customers' peace of mind. Trouw Nutrition's nutrition solutions have met the need of farmers and home-mixers, feed producers, integrators and distributors. Trouw Nutrition has locations in 25 countries and around 5000 employees. Our mission is Feeding the Future. Equal Opportunity Employer: Trouw Nutrition is an equal opportunity employer; applicants are considered for all roles without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, military status or any other status protected by applicable local law. Please advise us at any point during the recruitment and selection process if you require accommodation. Trouw Nutrition is committed to compliance with all applicable legislation, including providing accommodation for applicants with disabilities. Nutreco is a global leader in animal nutrition and aquafeed. Our advanced nutritional solutions are at the origin of food for millions of consumers worldwide. Its two global company brands Skretting (aqua feed) and Trouw Nutrition (animal nutrition) have sales in over 90 countries. Our purpose Feeding the Future captures a big challenge: feeding 9 billion people in 2050. Our responsibility is twofold: we need to make a significant contribution to meeting the rapid increase in worldwide demand for food; on the other hand, we need to find the right balance in order that we can realize growth while making also responsible choices for people and planet. We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and competence of our people. Our values; capable, caring, collaborative, and innovative are supportive of those three core elements. To know more about us, please visit our website https://www.nutreco.com
